try {
    for (const [id, value, type, role] of states) {
        createState(id, value, {
            name: id.split('.').pop(),
            type,
            role,
            read: true,
            write: true,
        });
    }
    log('EOS-Konfiguration ist angelegt.', 'info');
} catch (error) {
    log(`Config Fehler: ${error.message}`, 'warn');
}
